Professional Summary
Analytical and detail-oriented Financial Analyst with hands-on experience in preparing budgets, building financial models, and supporting FP&A processes. Skilled in spreadsheet modeling, variance analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to drive budgeting cycles and reporting accuracy. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
Financial Modelling, FP&A, Microsoft Excel, Budgeting, Confluence, Linux, Jira

Work Experience
Financial Analyst, Zentrix Labs (Nov 2025 - Present)
- Developed monthly financial models and scenario analyses using Microsoft Excel to support forecasting and decision-making, improving forecast accuracy for key product lines by refining assumptions and formulas.
- Led budgeting activities for two product teams, coordinating inputs via Confluence and tracking approvals in Jira, ensuring on-time submission of quarterly budgets and documenting changes.
- Performed variance analysis between actuals and budget, identifying cost drivers and recommending corrective actions that reduced discretionary spend in a pilot area.
- Automated recurring Excel-based reports and templates to streamline FP&A workflows, shortening the monthly close preparation time.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
